title: Amlok financial transaction taxonomy
counting_method: Category count includes mutually exclusive leaf definitions, including explicit unspecified/unknown leaves. Independent axes, provider codes and time-window attribute instances are not counted as additional categories.
classification_policy: Economic purpose, account movement, merchant sector, counterparty, payment rail/channel and card event are independent axes.
Confidence is a qualitative evidence-strength assessment, not a calibrated probability or independently measured classification accuracy.
Merchant category codes describe merchant activity and do not prove the purchased item, business purpose, capitalization or tax treatment.
Card issuer purchases increase liability without immediate cash outflow; depository card settlements reduce cash and liability. Do not add both as operating cash spending.
Only evidence-supported same-owner transfers are eliminated; cash deposits, processor payouts, loan proceeds and owner contributions are not automatically sales.
Pending authorizations, settled postings, refunds and reversals retain lineage and must not be counted as independent final economic activity.
Unavailable and conflicting classification remains explicit. No consumer protected-trait or lifestyle risk categories are inferred.
A defined category is not proof that every provider supplies sufficient fields to populate it.
